name: Riazen Academy
source:
This is Riazen Academy, that’s pronounced rye, like the bread and zen, like the state of mind. In Riazen academy, you’ll take the role of the headmaster of a prestigious higher learning academy set in a fantasy world of demons, angels, elves and all manner of monstergirls.

Split between a large cast of both main and supporting characters, from a goblin with no filter to a giant that could crush you with a hug there should be something for everyone here at Riazen. If you don’t want a bit of everything, all of the main characters are entirely optional and all of the potentially divisive kinks can be turned off entirely.

[From [url=https://games-aegis.itch.io/riazen-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
